digest.component_or_area: live DC harness + rich-text codec + inbound/outbound differ
propositions: Live DC harness must assert rendered HTML (bold/heading/code-macro) via ?expand=renderedFields API, not just wiki source, to verify Jira's interpretation of pushed rich bodies.

State-based echo-safety must hold: a converged DC rich body re-read on a second reconcile pass must compute no inbound/outbound mutations (the landed wire form matches local Markdown when mapped through the codec).

Settled conflict behavior under both-sides divergence (rebar-side AND Jira-side edits to the same field before next pass) must emit rebar's body locally and record a deduped outbound-field-conflict bridge alert without clobbering the remote value.
Inbound differ must treat Jira's echoed wiki as unchanged when it matches the local body's wire form (map_fields_to_remote), mirroring the outbound differ's _baseline_form_matches echo-suppression.

The public normalize_rich_text seam (InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text) must pin back-compat via a cross-repo contract test so breaking changes to its signature or behavior fail before the agentic-dev-platform import is broken.
